# Functions cmd/coveragecheck does not count when it checks the changed lines of
# a pull request (#1442). One per line: the path, the function (`name` or
# `Type.method`), then `#` and the reason. Only for code no test can reach. An
# entry without a reason, or for a function that no longer exists, fails the
# check.
cmd/advisorycheck/main.go main # one line: os.Exit around run, which the tests call
cmd/cfgaudit/main.go main # one line: os.Exit around run, which the tests call
cmd/ciduration/main.go main # one line: os.Exit around realMain, which the tests call
cmd/coveragecheck/main.go main # one line: os.Exit around run, which the tests call
